proof.text: For the primed unit-square-counit exchange alpha and any bounded constructible complex K, apply [stage3-sfb-open-base-change-component-mono]. Its equality premise is reflexivity after unfolding the primed exchange and its three steps: the adjunctions, square comparison and unitors are exactly the displayed formula. Thus alpha.app K is monic. The hypotheses on the coefficient ring, field, schemes and cartesian square agree verbatim.

Apply [stage3-sfb-open-base-change-component-section] to the same alpha, with the same reflexive formula identification, obtaining beta with beta followed by alpha.app K equal to the identity. Cancel the monomorphism alpha.app K from (alpha.app K followed by beta) followed by alpha.app K = alpha.app K; associativity and the section equation give alpha.app K followed by beta = identity. These two equations exhibit alpha.app K as an isomorphism.

Use CategoryTheory.NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app to conclude that the natural transformation alpha is an isomorphism. No naturality of independently selected component inverses must be proved separately, since this standard component criterion constructs the natural inverse.
